screen.jaymoskitchen.butcher.yield: Gets about %sx what you would on a butcher block
screen.jaymoskitchen.butcher.flavour.0: "I'll try not to waste too much of it."
screen.jaymoskitchen.butcher.flavour.2: "I know my way around a carcass."
screen.jaymoskitchen.butcher.flavour.4: "Watch. I'll get three of yours out of this one."
screen.jaymoskitchen.butcher.unheard: You've heard nothing about this butcher's work. Ask around.
screen.jaymoskitchen.butcher.boast: "Best cuts for a hundred miles, friend."
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.0.0: Don't let %s near your livestock. Turned my good pig into mush last week.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.0.1: %s? Half the meat ends up on the floor. I'd do it myself before I paid that one.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.1.0: %s's cuts are a bit ragged, if I'm honest. You get what you pay for.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.1.1: %s means well, but they waste more than they keep.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.2.0: %s does honest work. Nothing special, nothing to complain about.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.2.1: You could do worse than %s. You could do better too.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.3.0: %s knows their way around a carcass. Hardly anything goes to waste.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.3.1: Take your animals to %s. You'll come back with more than you'd think.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.4.0: We're lucky to have %s. Gets three times the meat out of a cow that you or I would.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.local.4.1: Folk come from miles to have %s butcher for them. A true master.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.far.good.0: There's a master butcher about %2$s blocks %3$s of here, %1$s by name. Worth the walk.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.far.good.1: My uncle swears by a butcher called %1$s, some %2$s blocks %3$s. Wastes nothing, he says.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.far.bad.0: If you're ever %2$s blocks or so %3$s of here, steer clear of the butcher %1$s. A butcher in name only.
gossip.jaymoskitchen.butcher.far.bad.1: A trader told me about a butcher called %1$s, about %2$s blocks %3$s. Ruins every carcass you give them.
